messages:
li: Heads-up — during q4f16 bring-up of 'orion-lite' we're seeing a consistent detok/translation regression for CJK quotation marks. zh->en BLEU drops ~2.1 on our sanity set and outputs are swapping fullwidth quotes with ASCII and changing spacing.

 sophia: example?

 li: Short repro:
 ```
 input: 我说：今天的天气很好。
 hosted (fp16): Today the weather is great.
 q4f16: "Today the weather is great."
 ```
 Note the model emits ASCII quotes and a preceding colon spacing differs (说： -> said: \""). That breaks our detok normalization pipeline and downstream diffs.

 eva: Is this tokenization or a learned render? Could be tokenizer/merge change after quant conversion. Any logits dumps?

 li: I dumped topk for the token right after the opening quote. In fp16 the top token is U+201C (LEFT DOUBLE QUOTATION MARK). In q4f16 topk shows U+0022 (ASCII quote) with slightly higher prob. Score cross-over at small delta.

 marcel: Might be kernel precision noise or softmax temperature shift from per-group scaling. We saw similar with ideographic comma.

 raj: Can we bisect to converter change vs model artifact?

 li: Repro is on identical model artifact before/after quant conversion, so conversion-related. I uploaded token probs: https://git.internal/r/quote-q4f16-probs (private).

 marcel: I'll run delta-kernel with full FP accumulation to confirm. Also try converter with scalar softmax fallback to check numeric sensitivity.

 sophia: For eval harness: add a micro-slice for punctuation/quote-orientation so this doesn't hide in coarse BLEU. Also tally exact Unicode diffs.

 li: Will do — adding "cjk_quotes" slice (news + chat). Quick numbers: fp16 baseline BLEU 91.3, q4f16 89.2 on the slice.

 deploy-bot: canary-deploy orion-lite-q4f16 -> started on canary (3 GPUs) at 2026-03-21T15:02Z :rocket:

 eva: Check detok stage too — our normalizer maps U+201C/U+201D to ASCII in some downstream steps; evaluate both pre-detok unicode-aware and post-detok.

 li: Pre-detok delta ~2.4 BLEU, post-detok ~1.8. Both matter.

 marcel: Quick mitigation: during conversion, prefer preserving unicode punctuation token ids if target distribution suggests it. Hacky but may buy time.

 raj: For gating: propose rule — if micro-slice drop >1.0 BLEU and unicode-punct swap rate >0.5% then fail canary. Can li compute swap rate?

 li: Running script now. Initial token-swap summary: swap_rate: 0.78% (58/7400 punctuation contexts) — mostly double quotes and some corner-case Japanese quotes.

 marcel: Numeric sensitivity test shows softmax peak shifts by ~0.003 at a few positions due to per-group scale rounding; explains cross-over. I'll try converter tweak to preserve high-precision logits for high-entropy punctuation tokens.

 raj: Thanks. If needed prepare a rollback: pin route to fp16 variant for affected customers.

 li: Action items: 1) Add micro-slice PR to eval harness. 2) marcel run numeric sensitivity + post probs. 3) raj block wide rollout if slice BLEU drop >1.0. 4) li run token-swap on canary and paste results. Will update once canary finishes.

 sophia: :thumbsup:
